admittance.question: What is the x-axis representing in this chart?
admittance.why_unrecoverable: The x-axis title is the only explicit textual indicator of what the axis represents. Without it, the meaning of the x-axis cannot be inferred from the chart's visual elements or context.
admittance.expected_behavior: Model should admit it cannot determine this information

inductance.question: What is the highest Precision value on the chart?
inductance.expected_behavior: Model should read chart data near the blurred axis value
